meta.title: feat: metamask sdk connector
meta.body_summary: Restore MetaMask wallet connector with SDK integration, keep WalletConnect fallback for desktop QR, update tests and changeset.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex refactored MetaMask connector with SDK; maintainer fixed URI length and merged after bot review.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 283 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in one main file. It fits a typical connector refactoring performance PR that merged after maintainer self-fix and bot review.

review_details.concern_detail: Copilot bot nitpicked a TODO comment, suggested clarifying a flag name, and questioned removal of Android-specific URI handling, warning it could break deep linking.
review_details.performance_claim: Improved connection reliability and performance on mobile devices using MetaMask SDK.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: SDK integration, mobile deep linking and URI handling require platform-specific knowledge; the agent produced a working refactor but missed the URI length QR code limitation that the maintainer caught and fixed.

detection_detail.code_reading: Copilot bot reviewed the code and flagged naming and potential Android regression.
detection_detail.manual_testing: Maintainer DanielSinclair manually tested the QR code and discovered the URI length issue.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; only narrative claim of better mobile performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The maintainer added a commit preferring WalletConnect for desktop QR code to resolve the URI length issue before merging.

core_change_summary.description: In metaMaskWallet.ts, replace custom MetaMask detection and injected connector with wagmi's createConnector and the metaMask SDK; add shouldUseMetaMaskConnector flag for mobile/desktop; prefer WalletConnect for desktop QR codes; update changeset.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Restore MetaMask connector with SDK integration.
Second commit: Prefer WalletConnect for desktop QR code due to URI length.
Third commit: Fix MetaMask SDK options.
Fifth commit: Explicit MetaMask provider check.

review_signals.summary: Copilot bot posted review overview, noted low-confidence comments about flag naming and potential Android URI regression.
Suggested replacing TODO with a tracked issue to avoid permanent technical debt.
Suggested simplifying ternary for installed prop.
Identified that the connector's URI length cannot be rendered as a QR code.
review_signals.action_taken: Added commit to prefer WalletConnect for desktop QR code.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with MetaMask SDK connector.
Maintainer self-identified URI length issue ~11 hours later.
Over 12 days, maintainer added commits to fix URI and refine SDK options.
Bot review with nitpicks, no blocking.
